title: Blood of the Other
description:
The first time you memorise this Skill, choose the parent Species your lineage comes from and, if it has any, one of its subspecies or regional origins. Its creature type or types, its lifespan, its age of adulthood and its languages are yours.

For every Prerequisite, you count as a character of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin. Also choose one Skill from those of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin: it is Memorised without taking up any Memory and does not have to be bought. You can no longer change it. If that Species does not fix for itself what you inherit from it, as with Undead and Scothans, settle it with the GM.

Your maximum Energy is 8 plus half, rounded down, of the sum of your Spirit, your Energy Levels and every other source of maximum Energy. A negative Spirit counts in that sum. With +2 Spirit and 1 Energy Level, it is therefore 9 instead of 11, and with -1 Spirit and 3 Energy Levels, 9 instead of 10.

You cannot choose the same Species for {{Flesh of the One}}.
